SlideForge

Rust-native carousel slide generator

47 Slide Types

One binary. Zero dependencies. Production ready.

CORE DEFINITION

Design Tokens

deh-ZINE TOH-kens

Centralized design decisions (colors, spacing, typography, radii) encoded as platform-agnostic values that compile to CSS custom properties.

SlideForge uses tokens for all 47 slide types.

CORE DEFINITION

Pool-Based Presets

pool-BAYST PREH-sets

Presets define allowed slide pools and constraints; AI agents compose carousels by selecting from pools rather than hardcoding sequences.

Enables flexible, validated carousel generation.

Why Rust?

SlideForge chose Rust for the compile pipeline because it delivers deterministic sub-10ms rendering, zero runtime dependencies, and memory safety without garbage collection pauses. The binary embeds all templates and design tokens, making it a true single-file deployment artifact.

Validation Philosophy

Our validator catches layout issues at build time: text overflow, contrast violations, clipped content, and composition errors. It runs on the rendered HTML, not the source — what you validate is what you ship.
